q: How do we count the emissions of a multi-level car park?
title: Multi-level car park: emissions
short: A car park's own emissions are electricity for lighting, ventilation fans, lifts and boom barriers, at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Cars driving in are their owners' emissions, not the car park's. EV chargers on your bill are your Scope 2 unless metered and billed on.
audience: Malls, offices and car park operators

p: Motion-sensor lighting and CO sensors that run fans only when needed cut the load the most.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
